info.name: NovaCRM — Full API
info.description:
All HTTP APIs exposed by NovaCRM for integration testing.

# Quick start
1. Import this collection into Postman.
2. Set collection variables:
   - `base_url` — e.g. `http://localhost/nova-crm/public` or `http://nova-crm.test`
   - `api_token` — Sanctum personal access token (create under **API Tokens** in the CRM UI; requires `api.tokens` permission)
   - `organization_id` — your tenant organization ID (find it in Organization Settings → Profile / Billing, or any API response `organization_id`)
   - `lead_id` / `customer_id` / `opportunity_id` — IDs returned from create/list calls
   - `visitor_uuid` / `session_uuid` — copied from Set-Cookie after a marketing track call
3. Authenticated `/api/v1/*` requests use Bearer auth + `X-Organization-Id`.

# Organization ID
Every multi-tenant request should include header `X-Organization-Id: {{organization_id}}`.
Obtain the ID from Organization Settings (Profile or Billing) or from authenticated API responses.
See docs/api/overview.md for examples.

# Authentication example
Authorization: Bearer {{api_token}}
Accept: application/json
X-Organization-Id: {{organization_id}}

# How to push leads

## From your website (recommended)
1. On landing pages, call **Marketing → Track Page View** so NovaCRM issues visitor/session cookies and captures UTMs / click IDs.
2. On form submit, call **Leads → Create Lead (Website form)** with `source: "website"` and optional `visitor_uuid` / `session_uuid` from those cookies so attribution links.

## From Google Ads traffic
There is **no separate Google Ads inbound lead-push API** in NovaCRM.
Attribution works like this:
1. Ad click lands on your site with `gclid=...` in the URL.
2. Call **Marketing → Track Page View (Google Ads / gclid)** with that full URL — CRM stores `gclid` on the marketing touch and classifies paid search.
3. Call **Leads → Create Lead (Google Ads attributed)** with `source: "google_ads"` (or `website`) plus the `visitor_uuid` / `session_uuid` from step 2.
Offline conversion upload back to Google Ads is done from **Integrations** in the CRM UI (not a public create-lead endpoint).

## From Meta (Facebook / Instagram)
Meta pushes via **Webhooks → Meta Receive Event**. Lead forms are also synced/imported from **Integrations** in the CRM UI. The public webhook only verifies + ingests signed deliveries; processing is triggered from Integrations.

# API surface in this collection
| Area | Auth | Endpoints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Leads | Sanctum + org | GET/POST list/create, GET show |
| Customers | Sanctum + org | GET list, GET show |
| Opportunities | Sanctum + org | GET list, GET show |
| Marketing track | Public (cookies) | POST /marketing/track |
| Meta webhooks | Public (signature / verify token) | GET verify, POST receive |

Web session UI routes (imports, assignments, OAuth connect) are **not** REST APIs and are omitted.

item.name: How to get an API token

request.description:
This is a **browser UI** page (not JSON). Log into the CRM as a user with `api.tokens` + `api.access`, open **API Tokens**, create a token, paste it into the collection variable `api_token`.

Every `/api/v1/*` call also needs `X-Organization-Id` = your organization ID.

item.name: 1. Marketing Tracking (Website / Google Ads landings)
item.description: Public, unauthenticated. Used by your website JS on page load. Sets `nova_mk_visitor` and `nova_mk_session` cookies. Capture those UUIDs into `visitor_uuid` / `session_uuid` for lead create attribution.

exec: // Cookies are httpOnly — Postman may show them under Cookies.
// After a successful 204, copy visitor/session UUIDs from Set-Cookie
// into collection variables visitor_uuid and session_uuid.

request.description:
Records an anonymous page view. Response is **204 No Content** and sets tracking cookies.

Required: `event` (`page_view`), `url`.
Optional: `landing_page`, `referrer`, `occurred_at`.

Same endpoint as organic tracking. Put the **full landing URL including `gclid`** (and UTMs) in `url` / `landing_page`.

NovaCRM extracts `gclid`, classifies the channel as paid search, and stores the touch. Later lead create with the same visitor/session UUIDs attributes the lead to that Google Ads click.

Replace `Cj0KCQjw_TEST_GCLID` with a real gclid from an ad preview / click.
Example for non-Ads campaigns (email, social, etc.) via UTM parameters on the URL.

item.description: Authenticated Sanctum API. Permission: `api.access` + create/view lead abilities. Create is rate-limited (`api-lead-intake`).

request.description:
**Website → CRM lead push.**

Required: `name`, `phone`, `source`.
Optional: `email`, `form_type`, `source_url`, `service_interest`, `message`, `custom_fields`, `assigned_to`, `visitor_uuid`, `session_uuid`.

After tracking a page view, paste cookie UUIDs into `visitor_uuid` / `session_uuid` (or set collection vars) so first-touch attribution attaches.

Responses: `201` created, `409` duplicate, `422` validation, `429` throttled.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Google Ads Lead",
    "email": "ads.lead@example.com",
    "phone": "+1 555 0200",
    "source": "google_ads",
    "form_type": "landing_page",
    "source_url": "https://www.example.com/lp?gclid=Cj0KCQjw_TEST_GCLID",
    "service_interest": "consultation",
    "message": "Came from Google Ads landing page.",
    "visitor_uuid": "{{visitor_uuid}}",
    "session_uuid": "{{session_uuid}}"
}

request.description:
**Google Ads → CRM lead push (via website form).**

Flow to test end-to-end:
1. Run **Track Page View (Google Ads / gclid)** first.
2. Copy visitor/session UUIDs from cookies into collection vars.
3. Run this request with `source: "google_ads"`.

The `gclid` itself is **not** a create-lead field — it is captured on the marketing touch during tracking. Attribution uses `visitor_uuid` / `session_uuid`.

Valid `source` values include: `website`, `google_ads`, `facebook`, `referral`, `whatsapp`, `manual_entry`, `api`, `import`.
Smallest valid payload. Owner assignment uses the Assignment Platform when `assigned_to` is omitted.
Paginated customers. Optional `search` matches name/company. Supports the same metadata filter/sort query params as leads.
Single customer with assignee and creator.

item.name: 5. Meta / Marketing Webhooks
item.description: Public webhook entry for marketing providers. Path param `{provider}` is typically `meta`. Google Ads does **not** use this inbound webhook for lead create in NovaCRM.

query.description: Must match the tenant Meta webhook verify token configured in Integrations

request.description:
Meta subscription challenge. On success returns plain-text challenge (200). Wrong token → 403. Unknown provider → 404.

Set `meta_verify_token` to the value configured for your org’s Meta integration.

header.description: HMAC-SHA256 of raw body using Meta app secret. Invalid signature is rejected.

request.description:
Ingests a signed Meta webhook delivery. Successful accept returns plain text `EVENT_RECEIVED`.

**Note:** This endpoint records the event; lead import/processing is driven from Integrations (`process webhooks` / lead import), not automatically from this POST alone in all setups.

You must compute a real `X-Hub-Signature-256` for the raw body or the request will be rejected (401).
